text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — we're running a pen-test dry-run next Wed (2026-03-30). Need to validate RBAC changes, KMS access proxy, and audit-log exports for evidence. Looping in @mike, @oliver, @emma. Owners: decide temporary roles, evidence upload path, and retest window. :calendar:

mike: Ack. Timeline? Who owns ephemeral role creation & smoke rollback?

oliver: I can own ephemeral roles & the KMS proxy. Need list of ARNs and expected kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt scopes. Also confirm CloudTrail + k8s-audit will be preserved off-cluster for 90 days.

emma: For audit export we plan to push to S3 bucket `redwood-pt-evidence`. We'll create presigned upload URLs. Assessor needs read-only access while evidence window is open.

qa: Presigned URLs are easier (no temporary IAM for assessors), but we must record presign generation in the audit log and rotate links after the window.

mike: For RBAC, we'll create a k8s RoleBinding in namespace `pt-temp` with a time-bounded expiry annotation. Suggest pattern:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: pt-assessor-20260330
  annotations:
    redwood/expiry: "2026-03-30T23:00:00Z"
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: assessor@example.com
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: pt-assessor-readonly
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

oliver: KMS proxy plan: run a short-lived bastion with the `kms-proxy` binary that forwards Encrypt/Decrypt to the KMS key. Restrict SG to assessor IPs. Example runtime:

```
kms-proxy --listen 127.0.0.1:8443 --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcde --allow-ops Encrypt,Decrypt
```

sarah: We also must capture CloudTrail events for `GenerateDataKey`, `Decrypt`, and STS `AssumeRole`. Set a CloudTrail filter and export to the evidence bucket with object prefixes tagged by thread id.

emma: Retention policy: lifecycle to transition to GLACIER after 30d and retain for 90d before deletion. Is that compliant?

mike: That sounds fine. Also: disable automated log scrubbing during the window — we need raw logs.

qa: On remediation tracking: we'll use the `pt-remediation` tracker and tag tickets `pt:high`, `pt:medium`. Attach remediation snapshots to S3 (zipped PoC + stack traces).

sarah: Retest windows: primary retest 7 business days after report delivery, backup retest 14 days. Timezone: PST.

oliver: I'll schedule a canary retest in staging first, then production fallback. Need a rollback playbook in case the retest causes regressions.

emma: Paste quick rollback snippets?

mike: Sure, minimal commands to keep in runbook:

```
# helm rollback to previous release
helm rollback my-app 2

# restore old configmap
kubectl apply -f configmap-prod-rollback.yaml
```

sarah: Owners (hand-off): oliver (KMS proxy + ephemeral roles), mike (RBAC + rollback), emma (audit export + bucket policy), qa (evidence packaging + triage), sarah (overall PT owner & retest scheduler). @deploy-bot can you create calendar invites and an S3 path?

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "pt-dryrun-03-30" for 2026-03-30 18:00 PST. S3 path `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1764599999/` created. :white_check_mark:

sarah: Next steps: oliver to post KMS proxy AMI + SG, mike to open PR for RBAC changes, emma to provide bucket lifecycle + retention config, qa to prep evidence template. Reconvene Mon 03/28 10:00 PST for a pre-flight. :eyes:

mike: Will do PR by EOD Fri.

oliver: AMI + SG details posted in #eng-infra, will link here.

qa: Evidence template uploaded to the S3 path as `evidence_manifest.json`.

sarah: Thanks all — marking owners in the tracker and will close loop after pre-flight. :thumbsup:
